/* All Infoboxes - General */
.portable-infobox {
	border: 1px solid grey;
}
 
.portable-infobox.pi-background {
	background: black;
}/**/

/* All Infoboxes - Headers & Titles */
.portable-infobox .pi-title,
.portable-infobox .pi-header {
	color: black;
	font-weight: bold;
}
 
.portable-infobox .pi-title {
	background-color: white;
	text-align: center;
	font-size: 100%;
}
 
.portable-infobox .pi-header {
	background-color: #bbbbbb;
}/**/
 
 /* All Infoboxes - Images */
.portable-infobox .pi-image {
	background-color: #000000;
}/**/
 
 /* All Infoboxes - Data */
.portable-infobox .pi-data-label {
    font-weight: normal;
}
 
.portable-infobox .pi-data-value {
	text-align: right;
}/**/
 
 /* All Infoboxes - Navigation */
.portable-infobox .pi-navigation {
	text-align: center;
	background-color: #bbbbbb;
}/**/
 
 /* Theme - Swordform */
.portable-infobox.pi-theme-swordform .pi-title,
.portable-infobox.pi-theme-swordform .pi-image,
.portable-infobox.pi-theme-swordform .pi-navigation {
	background: black;
}
 
.portable-infobox.pi-theme-swordform .pi-title {
	color: #dddddd
}
 
.portable-infobox.pi-theme-swordform .pi-data-label {
	font-weight: bold;
}
 
.portable-infobox.pi-theme-swordform .pi-item-spacing {
    border-color: transparent;
}
 
.portable-infobox.pi-theme-swordform .pi-image-thumbnail {
    max-height: 130px;
    width: auto;
}/**/

/* Theme - Nation */
.portable-infobox.pi-theme-nation .pi-title,
.portable-infobox.pi-theme-nation .pi-header,
.portable-infobox.pi-theme-nation .pi-navigation a {
	color: white;
}

.portable-infobox.pi-theme-nation .pi-title,
.portable-infobox.pi-theme-nation .pi-navigation,
.portable-infobox.pi-theme-nation .pi-data {
	background: #424242;
}

.portable-infobox.pi-theme-nation .pi-header {
	background: transparent;
	border-bottom: 1px solid gray;
}

.portable-infobox.pi-theme-nation .pi-data {
	border-color: gray;
}/**/
